page.title: Alabama Termite Map
page.intro: Documented Alabama termite records from AU termite specimens, published county records, and an optional static iNaturalist snapshot.

sources.title: Sources & references
sources.museum_text: Specimens identified by termite researchers at Auburn University. Coordinates are privacy-generalized by up to 300 m and do not reflect exact collection points. Specimens will be available in the Auburn University Natural History Museum.
sources.inaturalist_text: Static snapshot dated {snapshot_date}. Records are licensed Research Grade/community-assessed observations and are not independently verified by the Alabama Termite Identification Service. Each iNaturalist observation is displayed as a 300 m-radius map circle.
sources.boundaries_text: Local Alabama county snapshot from U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb. Basemap tiles are from OpenStreetMap.

published_reference.title: Four decades of inland invasion by the Formosan subterranean termite in Alabama: expansion associated with transportation infrastructure.
